The July 2026 Project Gigabit contract table was updated on 20 July 2026.
The table is a snapshot of BDUK data held on 16 July 2026.
BDUK publishes contract-level Project Gigabit progress data monthly.
The contracted-premises figures include only premises in the initial scope of contracts.
Deferred-scope premises may not be reflected in the contract table.
In the table, CO denotes a Type C Call Off contract.
BDUK states that the contract table is not directly comparable with its official-statistics releases.
Variable ingestion lag means the table should not be used to assess whether contractual milestones have been met.
The contract data is rounded to the nearest 10 and reported numbers may not sum because of rounding.
The table reports a total of 838,490 initial-scope contracted premises.
The table reports a total of 287,510 built contracted premises.
Ofcom reported 29.4 million fixed broadband lines at the end of Q1 2026, up 282,000 or 1.0% year on year.
